nodes.context:
# Hansen GFC v1.12 (global_forest_change_2024_v1_12)

Direct forest cover and annual loss baseline; weak supervision only for monthly tasks.

Primary v1 baseline. treecover2000 + lossyear + datamask bands. Annual labels; not suitable as monthly ground truth (see ADR 0004). v3 potential as weak supervision signal.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded.
nodes.title: Hansen GFC v1.12 (global_forest_change_2024_v1_12)

nodes.context:
# Sentinel-2 MSI L2A

High-resolution optical signal for forest state and disturbance confirmation.

Core v2 input. 10 m optical. Cloud masking required. Monthly compositing with SCL or s2cloudless. v3: usable as input to weakly supervised model.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded. NDVI is derived from reflectance bands, not asserted to be a native dataset band.
nodes.title: Sentinel-2 MSI L2A

nodes.context:
# Sentinel-1 GRD (C-band SAR)

Cloud-robust SAR signal for forest structure and monthly disturbance confirmation.

Cloud-robust v2 complement to Sentinel-2. VV+VH polarizations. Requires speckle filtering and terrain correction. Backscatter sensitive to moisture and structure.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded.
nodes.title: Sentinel-1 GRD (C-band SAR)

nodes.context:
# GEDI Level 2A/2B (forest height and structure)

Canopy-height and structure reference for validation or auxiliary learning.

Forest height and canopy structure. Sparse footprint - not suitable for area estimation alone. v3: validation layer or auxiliary feature. Geographically limited by ISS orbit.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded.
nodes.title: GEDI Level 2A/2B (forest height and structure)

nodes.context:
# JRC Tropical Moist Forest (TMF)

Independent forest/non-forest and degradation reference for humid tropics.

Annual forest / non-forest classification for the humid tropics. Independent of Hansen GFC - useful for cross-validation. Includes deforestation / degradation classes.

Inventory access routes are historical assessments; select and verify provider, version, coverage and access at planning time. Individual scenes are excluded.
nodes.title: JRC Tropical Moist Forest (TMF)

# Agent agreement does not establish evidence independence

Separate agents, providers or contexts do not establish independent source lineage or scientific confirmation. Compare source acquisition and derivation groups, disclose conclusion exposure and retain contradictions and inconclusive findings. Sensor agreement does not establish cause.
nodes.title: Agent agreement does not establish evidence independence

nodes.context:
# Agent output requires reviewed promotion

Agent extraction and interpretation enter as candidates. Passing structural checks, a successful run or an evaluator agent cannot promote knowledge. Human review records an attributable decision and evidence basis. Disturbance candidates are not legal deforestation, confirmed forest state or causal loss labels. Hansen annual loss is not monthly ground truth.
nodes.title: Agent output requires reviewed promotion

nodes.context:
# Monthly non-claims

Hansen annual loss is not monthly ground truth. Annual agreement does not prove monthly correctness. Single-month anomalies do not prove loss or its cause. Monthly products are not legal deforestation ground truth.
nodes.title: Monthly non-claims

# Round-bound forest-cover research harness

Reusable research-governance contract under proposed ADR 0006. Select bounded roles and skills, freeze instructions, record actual execution, reconcile disagreements and request human review. This is distinct from a GeoFM processing harness. It installs no scheduler, delegation engine, model service or scientific validation. Operational rounds and results remain downstream.
nodes.title: Round-bound forest-cover research harness

# Matched-season interannual comparison

Compare corresponding seasonal windows in reference years and target year using optical and/or SAR. Align season, quality, coverage and sensor processing before calculating current minus reference. Decision rules require explicit configuration and validation. No performance superiority is asserted.

parameters.input_selection: optical | SAR | both, explicitly declared; listed observation edges are alternatives for sensor inputs

# Dataset and tool discovery

Discover, verify and explain datasets and their associated discovery, access and processing tools for forest-cover estimation, forest disturbance screening and land-surface classification (e.g. roads, agricultural fields, buildings, water, settlements). Provide cited, conditional advice to other agents and people planning processing pipelines. This is a **portable logical subagent role**, not a continuously running crawler, production pipeline or scientific authority.

This portable responsibility may be performed sequentially, in a separate session or by a native subagent. It is not an agent instance, permission boundary or evidence of execution. The cited role file defines inputs, outputs and stop conditions.
nodes.title: Dataset and tool discovery

nodes.context:
# Discrepancy analysis

Explain differences between calculated forest-removal area and published figures through a transparent decomposition instead of selecting one preferred number.

This portable responsibility may be performed sequentially, in a separate session or by a native subagent. It is not an agent instance, permission boundary or evidence of execution. The cited role file defines inputs, outputs and stop conditions.
nodes.title: Discrepancy analysis
